name: Maison Ikkoku ~Omoide no Photograph~
original_name: めぞん一刻 ～想いでのフォトグラフ～
source:
You are Godai Yuusaku. You begin the game in Godai's room no. 5. Now then, what should you do? First how about trying to get the beautiful Kanrinin-san of Maison Ikkoku? To do that you will want to enter her room right? And you can meet her face to face and drink tea... And after that you can take her hand and...

"Kanrinin-san!"

Call out Kanrinin-san...no, Kyouko's name.

"K-kyouko.....I love you!"

"We can't, Godai-san!"

"It's ok, Kyouko, Kyouko..."

Wait, we don't have time to be lost in fantasies.

Don't take this game too seriously, naturally. Like the original, because Kanrininsan is a jealous person, when you hurt her feelings you can't speak to her let alone enter her room. In addition you can bribe the inhabitants based on their weaknesses, but their mooching can get in the way...

Having handled the manager's mood, and the obstructions of the residents, Godai can finally enter the manager's room and find the thing that she keeps hidden secretly. "Could this thing be Otonashi Souichiro's xx!?"

"Shall I bring in some tea?"

The manager gets up from the seat, and you see a chance to put your hand on her XX! And then,

"Good afternoon! It's Mitaka"

Your rival Mitaka unexpectedly appears. "Grr-!" while Kyouko gives you a sharp look. In that manner, you think of how to shed some light on the mystery, and new ways of obstructing you appear. The idea is to reproduce the sense of confusion from the original work.

In other words, you are searching for the required items, and where to find them, in order to enter the manager's room many times. That is the purpose of the game. And what’s going to happen when you get them?! That’s still a secret. 

Well, here’s one last hint. Without a doubt there is an item that you are looking for that has been important for a while! A "photograph"! Adventure game, Maison Ikkoku (Photograph Memories) begins.

[From: [url=http://projects.mattsmessyroom.com/maisonikkoku/]Instruction Manual[/url]]
translation:
你就是五代裕作。游戏开始时，你身处一刻馆五号室。那么，现在该做什么？首先，不妨试着追求一刻馆那位美丽的管理员吧？为此，你肯定想进入她的房间，对吧？你可以与她面对面喝茶……然后牵起她的手……

“管理员！”

呼唤管理员……不，是响子的名字。

“响、响子……我爱你！”

“不行啊，五代先生！”

“没关系的，响子，响子……”

等等，现在可不是沉浸在幻想里的时候。

当然，不要把这款游戏看得太严肃。和原作一样，管理员很爱吃醋；一旦伤了她的心，你别说进入房间，连话都搭不上。此外，你还可以针对住户们的弱点贿赂他们，但这些白吃白喝的家伙也可能妨碍你……

安抚好管理员的情绪，排除住户们的干扰，五代终于得以进入管理员房间，寻找她秘密藏起来的东西。“这难道是音无惣一郎的某件东西！？”

“我去端些茶来吧？”

管理员从座位起身，你看准机会，正要把手伸向她的某件东西！就在这时——

“下午好！我是三鹰。”

情敌三鹰意外现身。“可恶！”响子则向你投来锐利的目光。就这样，当你设法查明谜团时，新的阻碍也会接连出现。游戏力图重现原作中那种一团混乱的感觉。

换句话说，你要寻找进入管理员房间所需的道具，以及这些道具所在的位置，并多次进入她的房间。这就是游戏的目的。等全部找到后会发生什么？！现在还是秘密。

最后再给一个提示。毫无疑问，你寻找的道具中，有一样很久以前便十分重要的东西！那就是一张“照片”！冒险游戏《一刻馆～回忆的照片～》由此开始。
